title: Christmas—and they are missing.
paragraphs: Across Germany, thousands of children must spend Christmas apart from their birth families. Yet not every out-of-home placement is lawful: families increasingly experience injustice when authorities and support systems act intrusively or unlawfully.
These children are minors—they cannot defend themselves. Let us give them a voice.

title: Silence instead of Christmas songs
paragraphs: While lights shine outside, thousands of children in Germany spend Christmas far from their families. Not always for justified protection—too often because of flawed or unlawful actions within the system.
They are not heard because they are small. Let us look, ask questions and give children their voice.

title: Where are they at Christmas?
paragraphs: Thousands of children in Germany are torn from their families and celebrate Christmas without their loved ones. Where authorities and support systems commit injustice, often only silence remains.
Children who are minors need allies. Let us give them a voice.
